answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 13839 Country: India Title: asalamualykum sir, 1)I follow deobandi maslak, i want to know that can i pray five times salah behind imam of Shahi Masjid Fateh puri delhi ( mufti mukaram). if no so can i pray only id prayers behind him because my family go to there to pray id prayer. 2) If i forgot to recite duaye quonote in thrid rakat of witer prayer and go to ruku and sajdah, while i am reciting darood ibrahim or another dua like alahuma inii zalamtunafsi....... can i do sajad sahu after compelete this dua in that rakat or pray new witer salah. 3)In which occasion i person say, Alhumdulillah, Mashalah, Subahnalah, Jazakalah Question: asalamualykum sir, 1)I follow deobandi maslak, i want to know that can i pray five times salah behind imam of Shahi Masjid Fateh puri delhi ( mufti mukaram). if no so can i pray only id prayers behind him because my family go to there to pray id prayer. 2) If i forgot to recite duaye quonote in thrid rakat of witer prayer and go to ruku and sajdah, while i am reciting darood ibrahim or another dua like alahuma inii zalamtunafsi....... can i do sajad sahu after compelete this dua in that rakat or pray new witer salah. 3)In which occasion i person say, Alhumdulillah, Mashalah, Subahnalah, Jazakalah Answer ID: 13839 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1064/1064=M/1430) If the beliefs of the imam are not amounting to shirk (associating partner to Allah) and he bears qualities necessary for imamah (leading prayer), one can perform (five-time and Eid) salah behind him. (2) There is no need to perform the Witr Salah anew, rather when you remember while reciting dua or durood, you should turn your head for salam and perform sajdah sahv (remedial prostration). (3) One should say Al-Hamdulillah as praise to Allah, Ma-sha-Allah is said to express admiration and surprise, while JazakAllah is called as dua for one who did a favour to you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
